26/S0.subgoal: Explain the distinction between the physiology of sensation and the process of perception.

26/S1.subgoal: Describe the structural organization of neurons and how they form a complex neural network.

26/S2.subgoal: Explain how the brain uses hierarchical processing to detect increasingly complex patterns.

26/S3.subgoal: Describe how the brain integrates real-time sensory input with long-term memory for stimuli interpretation.

26/S4.subgoal: Explain proprioception as a 'sixth sense' that informs the brain about body position and movement.

26/S5.subgoal: Explain how sensory mismatches in immersive systems can cause cybersickness and inform XR design.

26/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
